questions.q: Shareholders who are entitled to receive any unpaid dividends from past years before ordinary shareholders can receive a dividend for the current year are holders of
questions.explain: **Cumulative preference shares** carry the right that if the company cannot pay dividends in one year due to insufficient profits, the dividend entitlement accumulates and is carried forward. These accumulated arrears must be paid in full before any dividend is declared for ordinary shareholders.
